name: ProcessEmailMessages
label: Process Email Messages
description: Moves, deletes, or marks as unread an email (or a list of emails) retrieved by a Retrieve email messages action.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The action to perform on the email messages.

selectOptions.label: Delete
selectOptions.description: Deletes email messages from the server.

selectOptions.label: Move to Mail Folder
selectOptions.description: Moves email messages to a specified mail folder.

fields.name: MessageIds
fields.label: Email Messages to Process
fields.description: The IDs of the email messages to process.

fields.name: Port
fields.label: Port
fields.description: The port number for the IMAP server.

fields.name: EnableSSL
fields.label: Enable SSL
fields.description: If true, enables SSL encryption for the connection.

fields.name: Username
fields.label: Username
fields.description: The username for the IMAP account.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password for the IMAP account.

fields.name: AcceptUntrustedCertificates
fields.label: Accept Untrusted Certificates
fields.description: If true, accepts untrusted SSL certificates.

fields.name: MailFolder
fields.label: Mail Folder
fields.description: The destination mail folder for moving emails (required if 'Operation' is 'Move').
